name: same_snapshot_different_history_run_b
invariant: See the paired fixture: identical terminal Omega, different provenance.
explanation: Here Omega also ends at {3, 4}, reached via the same two Pop events plus a Refuse of 3 instead of a Bind of 3 and 4 (Refuse never touches Omega, so it stays at {3, 4}). The terminal option-space snapshot is byte-identical to the paired run, but the histories -- and thus what a later collapse rule could observe about 3 and 4 -- are not.
